root.label: Tesco introduces paid safe leave for domestic abuse victims

events.label: Tesco introduces paid safe leave for domestic abuse victims

slots.name: paid leave days
slots.sentence: The UK’s largest private-sector employer is offering up to three days of paid leave which can be taken flexibly for activities such as attending court hearings, arranging emergency accommodation, changing locks, securing childcare or separating finances.

slots.name: employee count
slots.sentence: Managers across the business, which employs 300,000 people, have also been trained to spot the signs of domestic abuse, support those affected and flag them to specialist services.

slots.name: women affected
slots.sentence: “Usdaw has long campaigned for support at work for survivors of domestic abuse and we are pleased to have successfully negotiated this new policy with Tesco.

slots.name: policy status
slots.sentence: Tesco has become the first supermarket to introduce paid “safe leave” for victims of domestic abuse, giving staff dedicated time to access support, secure their safety and take steps to move on with their lives.
